name: Lavender South
summary: South of Lavender MRT toward Kallang / Beach Road edges — EWL mid-town living with denser condo/HDB mix and nightlife spill as the lifestyle tax.
body: Lavender South is the shortlist when East-West Line mid-town access and walkable food matter more than quiet landed texture. The pocket sits south of Lavender station toward Kallang and Beach Road gravity; housing mixes mid-age condos with selective HDB edges. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and late options without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: nightlife noise nearer Beach Road, peak EWL loads, and estate-specific tank / booster notice culture. Compare with Rochor Fringe for arts-campus adjacency, Kallang Wave for stadium-side living, and Bugis South when denser retail wins.
bestFor: people who will book ActiveSG skating instead of condo court myths
watchOuts: Nightlife and weekend spill toward Beach Road
Water-tank / booster notices vary by estate
Serviced vs TA confusion on some blocks
housingMix: Mid-age condos with selective HDB / walk-up edges.
commuteNotes: East-West Line at Lavender; Kallang / Nicoll adjacency depending on block. Walk a Saturday night before you LOI.
